briefing: Markets fell hard today: the NASDAQ dropped 5.2% and the S&P 500 lost 3.7%. The screener returned no candidates and conditions are clearly risk-off, so I'm making no new buys and keeping the $546 cash. The seven current positions stay open, and the automatic -7% stop-losses and +12% profit targets will handle exits.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like tech and growth stocks, often moving money into safer places like cash or bonds. On these days it is usually smarter to hold off on new buys than to try to catch a falling market, and to let your stop-losses limit the damage on what you already own.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」（Risk-Off）是指投資者情緒轉趨謹慎，紛紛沽售科技股、成長股等較高風險資產，並將資金轉移至現金或債券等避險工具。遇上這類交易日，暫停建立新倉通常比逆市「接飛刀」更為明智，同時應讓止蝕機制為現有持倉控制損失。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks sold off broadly today. The NASDAQ fell 5.2% and the S&P 500 fell 3.7%, so growth and tech names were hit hardest. No news headlines came with today's data, so I can't name the cause; I can only report that the selling was sharp and spread across the whole market, which is what a risk-off day looks like.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面拋售，納斯達克指數急挫5.2%，標普500指數下跌3.7%，科技及成長股跌幅最為顯著。由於今日數據未附帶新聞標題，暫未能確定觸發跌市的具體原因；目前只能確認沽壓猛烈且遍及整個市場，屬典型的避險（Risk-Off）行情。
